item.title: Discover the Perfect Travel Companion for a Visit to the South Carolina Lowcountry in New Book
item.description: Reedy Press is pleased to announce the release of its newest guidebook, 100 Things to Do in the South Carolina Lowcountry Before You Die, by Lynn and Cele Seldon.

item.title: What Hartford Motorcycle Riders Face on City Streets That Cars Never Do
Henshaw, Edgmon Late Heroics Push Bucs to Win on Opening Day of 2026 Season
item.description: Charleston Southern opened their 2026 season on Friday night with a 6-3, come-from-behind victory over Bucknell.

item.title: Third-Period Surge Lifts Stingrays Past Greenville, 4-2
item.description: Trailing by a goal heading to the third period, the South Carolina Stingrays scored three goals in the final eight minutes to skate past the Greenville Swamp Rabbits, 4-2, on Friday night at the Bon Secours Wellness Arena.

item.title: Mayor Cogswell Announces Love Your Block Mini-Grants are Available for Community-Led Neighborhood Revitalization Projects
item.description: Today, Mayor Cogswell announced that applications are now open for the Love Your Block program.

item.title: Top Reasons Why More Families Are Choosing Home Care Over Facility Living
item.description: Families are changing how they think about aging. Many people prefer staying in their own houses. This shift helps people stay close to their memories and communities.

item.title: Silencing the Crowd: A Dominant Performance That Forces Boxing to Re-Evaluate Shakur Stevenson
item.description: In boxing, you will come across moments when the noises tend to fade away. This is not because the crowd has lost interest. It might happen because the events taking place in the ring might be immensely difficult to ignore. As a result, the cheers slow down, and conversations stop altogether. This fight created one such moment.

item.title: South Carolina Outlasts Greenville, 7-5
item.description: In a high-scoring affair, the South Carolina Stingrays never trailed and scored a season-high seven times to defeat the Greenville Swamp Rabbits, 7-5, on Saturday night at the North Charleston Coliseum in front of 5,369 fans.

item.title: Pink Cactus to Host "South Carolina Cocktails" Book Signing on Feb. 23
item.description: Pink Cactus will host a book signing on Monday, Feb. 23, from 5 to 7 p.m., celebrating the release of South Carolina Cocktails: An Elegant Collection of Over 100 Recipes Inspired by the Palmetto State

item.title: South Carolina Tops Jacksonville 3-1 For Third Straight Win
item.description: In the final game of a three-game weekend, two third period goals lifted the South Carolina Stingrays past the Jacksonville Icemen, 3-1, on Sunday afternoon at the North Charleston Coliseum in front of 6,073 fans.
